meta.title: Companies worth following
meta.note: Auto-tracked: the companies most active in the curated event log, each with its latest dated development. Machine-written from gated facts only; no hand-written copy.

companies.name: Pemex
companies.signal: The state oil company's admission of accounting problems dating back years could complicate its access to financing at a time when investors are already wary of its debt load.

companies.name: Femsa
companies.signal: The retail giant, owner of Oxxo, is considering a banking license for Spin as it looks to expand into consumer credit with backing from venture fund QED Investors.

companies.name: Vulcan Materials
companies.signal: An international tribunal rejected nearly all of the US mining company's claims but ordered Mexico to pay a fraction, about 1%, of what Vulcan sought over restrictions on its quarry operations.

companies.name: BMW
companies.signal: BMW will begin assembling its next-generation electric vehicles and batteries at its San Luis Potosí plant in 2027, part of a broader push by automakers to expand production capacity in the country.

companies.name: Talos Energy
companies.signal: The deal advances the Polok and Chinwol deepwater discoveries toward a planned 2027 investment decision, adding a private partner to Mexico's offshore oil development effort.

companies.name: First Majestic Silver
companies.signal: The Canadian miner will sell its inactive San Martin silver-gold mine to a private Mexican buyer under a deal with an upfront payment and deferred terms, closing out a dormant asset.
